# Traveling Partner

> Book taxis, pool rides, deliveries, logistics, and trips across Pakistan — upfront fares and live tracking.

Traveling Partner is a ride-booking website and app for everyday travel in Pakistan. Use it to book a taxi, share a pool ride, send a delivery, move cargo, or plan an out-of-town trip.

## Site

- [Home](https://traveling-partner.com/): Overview of all services
- [About Us](https://traveling-partner.com/about): Company and community
- [Taxi Ride](https://traveling-partner.com/taxi-ride): Point-to-point taxi booking
- [Pool Ride](https://traveling-partner.com/pool-ride): Shared rides on the same route
- [Delivery](https://traveling-partner.com/delivery): Parcel delivery with live tracking
- [Logistics](https://traveling-partner.com/logistic): Business fleet and cargo
- [Tourism](https://traveling-partner.com/tourism): Intercity and trip booking
- [Blog](https://traveling-partner.com/blog): Guides and travel news
- [Help Center](https://traveling-partner.com/help): Support articles
- [Contact](https://traveling-partner.com/contact): Contact form and phone
- [Privacy Policy](https://traveling-partner.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Service](https://traveling-partner.com/terms-conditions)
